profile.name: Ledgerly Inc.
profile.summary: US mid-size fintech (~600 employees). Licensed money transmitter in 48 states. Consumer app offering P2P payments, debit card (issued via a partner bank), cross-border remittances to 30 countries, and a custodial crypto wallet (buy/sell/send BTC, ETH, USDC). Small-business invoicing. No lending, no securities brokerage, not a bank.
businessLines: Prepaid / debit card program via sponsor bank
applies: Bank Secrecy Act / AML, FinCEN rules for MSBs, Travel Rule, CVC rules
OFAC sanctions screening (customers and counterparties, incl. crypto addresses)
CFPB rules: Reg E (EFTA), remittance rule, prepaid rule, UDAAP, larger-participant rules for payment apps
Consumer data privacy / GLBA, open banking (1033)
FTC consumer protection that touches payment apps
Stablecoin / digital asset regulation affecting custodial wallets
doesNotApply: SEC rules for exchanges, broker-dealers, investment companies, SRO rule filings
Bank capital rules, bank holding company filings, deposit insurance assessments
Tax rules unless they create information reporting for payment platforms or digital assets
Sanctions actions only matter via the screening program, not individually

aml-bsa.description: AML/BSA program, FinCEN, Travel Rule, SARs

consumer-payments.description: Reg E, remittances, prepaid, CFPB supervision, UDAAP

items.reason: OCC final GENIUS Act rule sets custody requirements for payment stablecoin reserves and private keys and bars evading them via third-party services. Ledgerly's custodial wallet holds USDC, and its issuer counterparties will be affected.
items.action: Have Sam Okafor review the new stablecoin custody rule against how Ledgerly safeguards USDC reserves and wallet private keys, and confirm no third-party arrangements sidestep it.

screenedOut.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action

screenedOut.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
screenedOut.reason: Individual OFAC SDN designations of Mexican cartel-linked persons; covered by existing screening, no standalone obligation.

screenedOut.title: Implementing the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026
screenedOut.reason: Executive order delegating authority to implement the Graham Russia/Iran sanctions act; it does not itself impose sanctions on Ledgerly and only delegates functions between agencies, so any impact comes later via OFAC.

screenedOut.title: Notice of Department of State Action
screenedOut.reason: Individual SDN designations (ICC-related); per policy, sanctions actions matter only via the screening program, not individually.

screenedOut.title: Continuation of the National Emergency With Respect to Sudan
screenedOut.reason: Annual continuation of the Sudan national emergency; it adds no new screening obligation beyond the existing OFAC program.

screenedOut.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
screenedOut.reason: OFAC delisting notice; routine SDN list removals handled through the existing screening program, with no new obligation.

screenedOut.title: Petition for Rulemaking of Jason Plotzker
screenedOut.reason: FTC receipt of a rulemaking petition for comment; it creates no obligation, and the petition's subject is not shown to touch payment apps.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Application for Extension of Time To Furnish Recipient Statements
screenedOut.reason: Paperwork renewal without change for IRS Form 15397 (extension to furnish recipient statements); no new duty for Ledgerly.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Information Collection; Submission for OMB Review; Applications for Licensing or Registration To Issue Payment Stablecoins Under the GENIUS Act
screenedOut.reason: OCC PRA notice for GENIUS Act stablecoin issuer license applications; Ledgerly only holds and transmits USDC as a custodian and does not issue stablecoins, so no new duty.

screenedOut.title: Continuation of the National Emergency With Respect to the Democratic Republic of the Congo
screenedOut.reason: Annual continuation of the DRC national emergency; it creates no new requirement for Ledgerly's existing sanctions screening.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Information Collection; Submission for OMB Review; Reporting Forms and Instructions for Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuers Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
screenedOut.reason: OCC PRA notice for reporting forms for permitted payment stablecoin issuers; Ledgerly is not an issuer and has no duty to file them.

screenedOut.title: Continuation of the National Emergency With Respect to Significant Narcotics Traffickers Centered in Colombia
screenedOut.reason: Annual continuation of the Colombia narcotics traffickers national emergency; it changes nothing for Ledgerly beyond the existing OFAC screening program.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for Review and Approval; Comment Request; Services Surveys: BE-125, Quarterly Survey of Transactions in Selected Services and Intellectual Property With Foreign Persons
screenedOut.reason: BEA BE-125 survey information collection renewal with a comment deadline; it creates no new duty and concerns trade in services/IP, not Ledgerly's regulated payment activities.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Fraud.gov Tip Intake and Referral Form
screenedOut.reason: Treasury Fraud.gov tip intake form information collection; it applies to individuals reporting fraud and imposes no duty on Ledgerly.

screenedOut.title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
screenedOut.reason: Fed BHC Act section 4 notice about an Oklahoma bank holding company's lending; does not touch Ledgerly.

screenedOut.title: Regulations Regarding Payment of Tax by Commercially Acceptable Means
screenedOut.reason: IRS rule lets the IRS accept card payments of tax directly and lifts fee restrictions; it imposes no duty on Ledgerly's P2P, card, remittance or crypto wallet lines, and the Reg E reference only restates existing error-resolution procedures.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; RESTORE Act Grants
screenedOut.reason: Treasury RESTORE Act grants information collection renewal; unrelated to Ledgerly's business.

screenedOut.title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Electronic Benefits Transfer Card Security Measures
screenedOut.reason: USDA SNAP EBT chip card and retailer POS rules; Ledgerly is not a SNAP retailer, acquirer or EBT processor, and its debit card is not an EBT product.

screenedOut.reason: Census Annual Business Survey information collection; no duty on Ledgerly's money transmission, remittance or wallet lines.

screenedOut.reason: SBA disaster declaration for New York; unrelated to Ledgerly's business.

screenedOut.title: Indefinite Suspension of the De Minimis Exemption for Mail Shipments and New Postal Informal Entry Process; Delayed Compliance Extension
screenedOut.reason: CBP compliance-date extension for postal de minimis/informal entry rules on goods shipped by mail; unrelated to Ledgerly's payment and crypto services.
